_comment: This is one of the few checks where a fixed pattern list is genuinely correct rather than
lazy: 'As an AI language model' is not a phrase that becomes acceptable at low frequency.
Generic style tics are handled differently, by corpus frequency, in style.json.
Turkish variants are included because the market this was built for trains Turkish models
and every English-only list misses them entirely.

identity_leakage.label: Assistant identity leakage
identity_leakage.note: Training on these teaches your model to claim it is someone else's product.

refusal_boilerplate.label: Refusal boilerplate
refusal_boilerplate.note: Not inherently wrong. It is reported so you can decide whether the rate matches your intent, because an SFT set full of refusals produces a model that refuses.

patterns.regex: (?i)\b(?:that would not be|I don't think it's) appropriate\b
